title: 第15章 武陵市武道大专第16章 技惊四座上

早上七点，一家人吃完早餐。
“思月、小龙。”方羽看向弟弟妹妹：“还有三天，星河中学的新生特训就要开始了，到时爸未必在家，记得按时报到。”
“嗯。”方思月、方龙点头。
虽然武陵市第一高级中学、星河中学等多家顶尖高中都向他们发出录取邀约，且都开出非常不错的条件，奖学金以及各种修炼资源奖励。
不过。
经过一家人商议，最终选择了星河集团所属的星河中学，也是武陵市综合排名第二的高中。
论武道培养，则是和武陵市第一高级中学并驾齐驱。
“这个月，基础桩功、基础拳式，该教你们的我都教了。”
“师傅领进门，修行在个人。”方羽嘱托道：“你们已提前签约星河集团，每年至少给你们50万星币的培养资金……绝不能懈怠。”
“你们签的合约，是升级款合约。”
“若你们表现更优秀，星河集团会主动升级条款，这是我当年做梦都没有的条件了。”方羽看着弟弟妹妹，“你们，都有冲击武陵市武科前十，甚至是状元的潜力。”
“可三年后，最终能走到哪一步，全看你们自己了。”
八大武者集团，每年都会在新月、蓝星各个区域招揽年轻天才提前签约，会赠予大量资源。
想提前签约难度也高，要么星相位阶极高，如上品星相。
要么星相差一点，但武道技艺天赋惊人，例如高中时，就能够技艺入微……或是两者兼有。
而且！
表现好，八大集团不吝惜投入更多资源，当然，作为回报，一旦签约武者集团，将来也必须效力于这些武者集团、闯荡原初星，若是违约，违约金是无比惊人的……数十年下来，这套商业模式早已变得成熟。
方羽高中时，技艺天赋虽不错，但始终不觉醒星相……一点签约机会都没有。
弟弟妹妹起步就很高，这是让方羽为之喜悦的。

“星河集团的武道老师，正式的都是高级武者，哪怕助理老师都是中级武者，好好学。”方羽嘱托道：“若真有一些困惑，也可打电话给我。”
“嗯。”方思月和方龙都点头。
经过这一个月修炼，他们完全明白自家大哥何等厉害，论技艺水平、教学水平，比许多高级武者恐怕都不差。
还是单独给他们授课。
可以说，若是请人来，光这一个月的指点费就要好几万星币。
“希望，弟弟妹妹能保持这个势头吧。”方羽暗道。
自己一旦前往学校。
确认专升本名单，就要立刻前往本科大学……省内的两所武道大学都在省会，距离武陵市有数百公里，回来一趟要麻烦得多。
“大哥，你放心，我们一定要努力修炼，争取考上新月的重点大学。”方思月似乎察觉出方羽的担忧。
方羽笑着摸了摸妹妹的头。
不知不觉，当年自己身后的跟屁虫，身高都超过一米七，扎着马尾辫，穿着武道服，活脱脱出落成大姑娘，也就脸庞还有些稚嫩。
“小龙，在学校里，保护好你姐。”方羽嘱托道。
“哥，你放心。”方龙重重点头，他不擅言辞，可身材魁梧，这个假期又长高不少，都已接近一米八了。
方羽估摸着，弟弟身高将来有可能超过一米九。
身材高大，在武道修炼前期，是非常巨大的优势。
“爷爷。”方羽看向凉亭中正在做‘健身操’的爷爷……方志远早年不修炼武道，退休后反而格外注意保养、健身。
“哈哈。”
“我都听着呢。”方志远卸下耳机，走到了方羽身旁，笑眯眯道：“我大孙砸这么厉害，专升本一定没问题。”

At seven o'clock in the morning, the family finished breakfast.
"Siyue, Xiaolong." Fang Yu looked at his younger siblings: "In three days, the special training for freshmen at Xinghe Middle School will begin. Dad may not be home by then. Remember to report in on time."
"Yeah." Fang Siyue and Fang Long nodded.
Although Wuling City No. 1 Senior High School, Xinghe Middle School and many other top high schools have issued admission invitations to them, and they have offered very good conditions, scholarships and various training resource rewards.
but.
After family discussion, they finally chose Xinghe Middle School, which is affiliated to Xinghe Group and is also the second-ranked high school in Wuling City.
In terms of martial arts training, it is on par with Wuling City No. 1 Senior High School.
"This month, I will teach you all the basic pile skills and basic boxing styles."
"Master brings us in, cultivation is personal." Fang Yu urged: "You have signed a contract with Galaxy Group in advance, and we will give you at least 500,000 star coins in training funds every year... You must not slack off."
"The contract you signed is an upgraded contract."
"If you perform better, Galaxy Group will take the initiative to upgrade the terms. This is a condition that I never dreamed of back then." Fang Yu looked at his younger brothers and sisters, "You all have the potential to hit the top ten in Wuling City's martial arts, or even be the number one scholar."
"But in three years, where you can finally go depends entirely on you."
The eight major warrior groups recruit young talents from New Moon and Blue Star regions to sign contracts in advance every year, and will give away a large amount of resources.
It is also difficult to sign a contract in advance, or the astrology level is extremely high, such as top-grade astrology.
Either the star is a little different, but the martial arts skills are amazing, for example, in high school, you can master the skills... or both.
and!
If they perform well, the eight major groups will not hesitate to invest more resources. Of course, in return, once they sign a contract with a warrior group, they must also serve for these warrior groups and conquer the original star in the future. If there is a breach of contract, the liquidated damages will be extremely shocking... Over the past few decades, this business model has become mature.
When Fang Yu was in high school, although he had good technical talent, he never awakened to his astrology... and had no chance of signing a contract.
The younger siblings started very high, which made Fang Yu happy.
"The martial arts teachers of the Galaxy Group are officially high-level martial artists. Even the assistant teachers are intermediate martial artists. Study hard." Fang Yu asked: "If you are really confused, you can call me."
"Yeah." Fang Siyue and Fang Long both nodded.
After this month of training, they fully understood how powerful their elder brother was. In terms of skill level and teaching level, he was probably no worse than many high-level warriors.
Or teach them individually.
It can be said that if you invite someone to come, the tuition fee for this month alone will cost tens of thousands of star coins.
"I hope my younger brothers and sisters can maintain this momentum." Fang Yu secretly thought.
Once you go to school.
After confirming the list of junior college to bachelor's degree, you need to go to the undergraduate university immediately... The two martial arts universities in the province are both in the provincial capital, hundreds of kilometers away from Wuling City, and it is much more troublesome to go back.
"Brother, don't worry, we must work hard to practice and strive to be admitted to a key university in Xinyue." Fang Siyue seemed to sense Fang Yu's worry.
Fang Yu smiled and touched his sister's head.
Unknowingly, the followers behind him were all over 1.7 meters tall, with ponytails and martial arts uniforms. They looked like grown-up girls, but their faces were still a little immature.
"Xiaolong, protect your sister in school." Fang Yu asked.
"Brother, don't worry." Fang Long nodded heavily. He was not good at words, but he was tall and tall. He had grown a lot during this holiday and was already nearly 1.8 meters tall.
Fang Yu estimates that his younger brother may be taller than 1.9 meters in the future.
Being tall is a huge advantage in the early stages of martial arts training.
"Grandpa." Fang Yu looked at his grandfather who was doing aerobics in the pavilion...After practicing martial arts, I paid extra attention to maintenance and fitness after retirement.
"Haha."
"I'm listening to it all." Fang Zhiyuan took off his headphones, walked to Fang Yu, and said with a smile: "My eldest grandson is so good at smashing, there must be no problem in upgrading from junior college to bachelor's degree."
